name: SSD for the Pi
notes: Official 256 GB NVMe kit (M.2 HAT+). Price is an estimate: one EU shop lists €134–160. Check the HAT fits in the official case before ordering.

name: NAS: health-check old drives
notes: SMART check on every old drive; copy off any that are failing. If one is failing, move the NAS back up to #3.

name: Film archive: supplies + index
notes: Print File clear sleeves (€49.90/100), A4 maxi binders, light pad (price not checked). 6 h gets every roll into Lux Archive, not scanned.

name: Omnium baby setup
notes: Child Seat Rack (€120) + Yepp Nexxt 2 Maxi or Qibbel Air (seat price not checked), cold-weather kit. Security gear not included.

name: Sony SRS-50 web radio
notes: Pi Zero 2 W or ESP32 + amp + replacement drivers. The 10 h of building is hobby time, not budgeted.

name: CX bike
notes: Trek Crockett, singlespeed, 58 cm, used. Buy after the season. Target under €1,000, ceiling €1,500. Pickup and test ride not counted.

name: NAS
notes: UGREEN DXP4800 Plus + 3×8 TB, TrueNAS, Immich, restic to the Pi. Includes the Pi's backup drive and an NVMe boot SSD. Late-September prices. Below the CX bike while the old drives are healthy.

name: OM-10 lens
notes: Zuiko 85 f/2 or 100 f/2. Fits the Fuji via an adapter too, so it may be worth deciding after the camera.

name: Digital camera
notes: Used Fuji X-S10 + OM adapter. A dealer lists one at €899; private sales should be lower (not checked).
